description:
Goal

A demanded callable TransportShape(position) determines the function/value representation once from exact upstream facts and products. That revision-relative product answer is the authority consumed by ABI, backend, interpreter, and native layers; none of them reselect, reconstruct, or reinterpret callable identity or layout.

North-star contract

- Artifact work is product-keyed and request-local. One product produces from named current fact/product prerequisites or returns exact waits.
- Completion is explicit: when all prerequisites requested by that product have produced for the revisions it reads, that answer may settle. A closure-wide no-change sweep is not completion evidence.
- A producer may settle a dependency group internally only when a real cycle requires it. It publishes the requested revision-relative answer, not an eagerly projected inventory.
- RootBackendProduct only densifies symbolic products already demanded into the request-local inventory.
- Transport owns the physical callable/function determination. Lower layers consume its product and never relitigate it.

Proven semantic/physical mismatch

Runtime demand records each call argument under an exact callee ExecutableKey plus semantic input slot before transport. Per-producer CallableFlowFact carries function, captures, direct/public surfaces, exact resolutions, and semantic input mappings. project_executable_input_source projects those sources into ShapeIds, then callable_input_shapes_for_demand compares them against a joined physical rendering of CallableDemand and decides producer eligibility again. Paired Enum.drop_while proves universal physical comparison rejects valid producers; existential physical comparison admits an untargeted same-layout producer. Replacing it with target/edge matching inside the same projection is still semantic reselection, not refinement. The earlier spike at 2e4f39973 is retained only as this negative proof.

Product-completion spike proof

Fresh spike 1160e672d0a8add31ac10d95404e746b36529d91 requested one paired-drop_while callable-input TransportShape through the production driver. Forward and reversed sibling-wait schedules returned the same callable ValueRef answer, but the one request caused solve_transport_closure to project 17 executables, compute 144 components and 282 component positions, mark 2 positions demanded, materialize 2 shapes, and side-publish 2 callable inventories, 1 construction, and 4 boundary inventories while settling zero CallableFacts or BoundaryFacts products.

The full root trace projected 25 executables, 207 components, and 408 positions, then record_* inserted 5 callable and 9 boundary ids/facts into demanded_* sets. The next RootBackendProduct retry scanned those production-populated sets and requested 14 snapshot facade products. Production manufactures the requests that supposedly justify it.

The session conflates external requests, equality-component reachability, pass-side-produced facts, and root inventory membership:

- record_transport_component/layout mark produced component members as demanded positions.
- record_callable_facts and record_boundary_facts mark side-produced ids demanded.
- IncomingInputSlot has no waits or exact contributor domain. It settles [] -> [A] -> [A,B] as outgoing edge products happen to publish contributors. New edges invalidate the slot, so snapshots are revision-relative, but none proves all currently required contributors have produced.
- CallableFacts and BoundaryFacts have no waits and snapshot optional session maps. An early None remains memoized after record_* publishes Some. Normal root ordering masks this because the closure pass publishes the id and facts together before manufacturing demand.
- solve_transport_closure is not SCC value settlement: its no-change loop discovers the scope of a multi-product pass, then projects every component. One connected equality component may require indivisible local settlement; that does not justify computing 143 unrelated components.

Next proof gate before implementation

1. For the requested drop_while input, label every shape constraint by its owning executable/fact/product and extract only the connected component reachable from the requested position. Measure the exact positions and dependencies actually needed, without treating the full graph as authority.
2. Define the candidate per-executable constraint/source product values and exact revision inputs on paper. Prove a requested component can discover its local equality group through named product waits rather than whole-executable closure expansion.
3. Locate the authority that can state the contributor domain for an input slot. If no existing fact/product can name all required outgoing-edge contributors, identify the missing product boundary; do not substitute session inventory, World scans, no-change loops, or later invalidation.
4. Treat callable construction as a separate producer-position question. Prove the exact settled producer/capture component and CallableFlowFact children needed to return its callable/construction answer and to name any CallableFacts/BoundaryFacts children.
5. Prove direct-versus-public callable representation is a transport determination over carried authorities, not producer filtering against joined physical surfaces. State the zero/multiple-alternative invariants.
6. Exercise forward/reversed waits and upstream revision changes. A product may be invalidated when a named input revision moves; it may not publish partial data merely because compensation later retracts it.
7. Only after these proofs, decompose implementation into atomic one-commit tickets and identify the whole-closure projection, demanded/produced conflation, snapshot facades, physical selector, fallback/cache machinery, obsolete tests, and docs that each ticket removes.

Signal

- One explicit requested-product DAG accounts for every dependency of the minimal callable component and no unrelated component.
- Every completion claim names its finite/revision-relative contributor domain.
- Paired drop_while retains both valid producer/use relations without physical eligibility selection.
- Same-layout distinct targets cannot cross-select because the exact relation is carried.
- Lower layers consume the produced function/ABI decision without semantic or physical reselection.
- Permanent tests will assert exact waits, products, revisions, and consumer behavior, not a closure cache representation.

Scope

No production implementation begins until the component/dependency spike proves both the exact product boundary and completion condition. fz-k22.30 remains blocked until this authority is known. fz-k22.31 owns the uncalled first-class discrepancy. fz-k22.29 owns lazy direct invocation only after this ticket establishes the product authority it may consume.
title: Make callable transport determination a product-owned refinement
